metadata.description: Steakhouse USDT is an immutable MetaMorpho (v1) ERC4626 vault, curated by Steakhouse Financial, that supplies depositor USDT into a curated set of Morpho Blue lending markets ($88.49M currently deployed across wstETH, WBTC, BTC, gold, ETH, DAI and cbBTC collateral). A 5-of-8 owner multisig holds the powerful roles (fee, curator, guardian, ownership) while a 2-of-6 curator multisig sets per-market caps and queues; all caps and timelock/guardian changes are gated by a 7-day timelock. An Aragon OSx DAO of vault depositors acts as guardian and can veto pending changes. Collateral pricing depends entirely on Chainlink feeds read through Morpho Blue.

admins.name: Owner (5-of-8 Multisig)
admins.description: Holds every owner-gated role on the vault: setFee (capped at 50% of yield), setCurator, setIsAllocator, setFeeRecipient, setSkimRecipient, submitTimelock, submitGuardian, and transferOwnership/renounceOwnership. Can also submit and accept market caps. transferOwnership and renounceOwnership are uncapped and critical; all parameter changes flow through the 7-day timelock and can be vetoed by the guardian. Reaches $88.49M of vault capital.

admins.name: Curator (2-of-6 Multisig)
admins.description: Steakhouse Financial curator multisig. Submits/removes per-market supply caps (submitCap, submitMarketRemoval) and manages the supply/withdraw queues and reallocation. Cap and market-removal changes are 7-day timelocked and guardian-vetoable; reallocation can only move funds into markets that already have a non-zero cap. Reaches $88.49M of vault capital, bounded by per-market caps.

7-day MetaMorpho timelock delay before submitMarketRemoval execution

admins.name: Allocator (EOA)
admins.description: Allocator EOA that can call setSupplyQueue, updateWithdrawQueue and reallocate. These only rebalance funds across markets that already have a curator-approved cap, so the role carries no direct fund-extraction power (scored no-impact).

admins.name: Allocator (1-of-5 Multisig)
admins.description: Secondary allocator multisig with the same reallocation-only powers (setSupplyQueue, updateWithdrawQueue, reallocate). Bounded by existing per-market caps; no direct fund-extraction power (scored no-impact).

admins.name: Guardian (Aragon OSx DAO)
admins.description: Aragon OSx guardian DAO whose voting power is held by vault depositors proportional to their deposit. Its only powers are vetoes (revokePendingTimelock, revokePendingGuardian, revokePendingCap, revokePendingMarketRemoval) executed during the 7-day timelock window. It cannot move funds or initiate changes, but its veto reach spans the entire vault ($88.49M); a compromised or inactive guardian removes the depositor backstop against malicious owner/curator submissions.

mitigations.description: Only revokes pending owner/curator submissions during the timelock window. Cannot extract funds or initiate state changes.

dependencies.name: Chainlink Feed Admin (Multisig)
dependencies.description: Owner multisig of the Chainlink aggregator proxies; can repoint the underlying aggregators. Operated by Chainlink, outside the vault's or curator's control.

dependencies.name: MorphoHelper
dependencies.description: Morpho periphery helper contract whitelisted as an allocator; used for reallocation across the vault's markets, bounded by existing per-market caps.

dependencies.name: wstETH / ETH Price Feed
dependencies.description: Custom wstETH/ETH exchange-rate price feed (built on Chainlink) used to price the wstETH-collateral markets.

dependencies.name: Chainlink USDT / ETH Feed
dependencies.description: Chainlink USDT/ETH price feed used as a quote feed in the wstETH market oracle stack.

dependencies.name: Chainlink WBTC / BTC Feed
dependencies.description: Chainlink WBTC/BTC proof-of-reserve-style price feed combined with BTC/USD to price WBTC collateral.

dependencies.name: Chainlink BTC / USD Feed
dependencies.description: Chainlink BTC/USD price feed used by the oracle adapters of the vault's BTC-collateral markets. A manipulated or stale value could misprice those markets and enable bad debt up to their deployed supply.

dependencies.name: Chainlink USDT / USD Feed
dependencies.description: Chainlink USDT/USD price feed used as the quote feed across several of the vault's market oracle adapters.

dependencies.name: Chainlink XAU / USD Feed
dependencies.description: Chainlink gold (XAU/USD) price feed for the vault's single gold-collateral market. That market's supply cap is the lowest in the vault, so a failure of this feed is bounded to a small fraction of total vault TVS rather than the full deposit base.

mitigations.label: Per-market cap
mitigations.description: This feed prices a single Morpho market with a $10M supply cap; exposure under a feed failure is bounded by that cap, well below total vault TVS.

mitigations.label: Per-market cap
mitigations.description: This feed prices a single Morpho market with a $10M supply cap; exposure under a feed failure is bounded by that cap, well below total vault TVS.

dependencies.name: Chainlink ETH / USD Feed
dependencies.description: Chainlink ETH/USD price feed feeding the ETH-denominated collateral markets via their MorphoChainlinkOracleV2 adapters.

dependencies.name: Chainlink DAI / USD Feed
dependencies.description: Chainlink DAI/USD price feed used by the DAI-collateral market's oracle adapter.

dependencies.name: Chainlink BTC / USD Feed (deviation-wrapped)
dependencies.description: Chainlink BTC/USD price feed consumed inside the MetaOracleDeviationTimelock primary/current oracle; the deviation guard adds a delay before large price moves are accepted.

dependencies.name: Chainlink cbBTC / USD Feed
dependencies.description: Chainlink cbBTC/USD price feed used inside the MetaOracleDeviationTimelock-wrapped cbBTC market oracle.

dependencies.name: Morpho Blue
dependencies.description: The Morpho Blue singleton lending protocol. The vault supplies all depositor USDT into permissionless Morpho markets and holds its entire $88.49M as supply positions here. Bad-debt accounting and liquidations on Morpho Blue directly determine whether the vault's positions are recoverable.

mitigations.description: Maximum fee is 50%

dependencies.name: Morpho PublicAllocator
dependencies.description: Shared Morpho allocator the curator has whitelisted as an allocator, letting third parties rebalance liquidity across the vault's markets within curator-set flow caps. No direct fund-extraction power.
